title: Chaotic Cows
description: If you hit cows, strange things can happen.
body:
**Chaotic Cow is a wild and unpredictable Minecraft mod that turns ordinary cows into the trigger for unexpected events.
What seems harmless at first can quickly lead to total chaos.**

When you hit a cow, powerful Bastions suddenly spawn in your world.
These structures emerge without warning, transforming peaceful landscapes into dangerous battlegrounds.

Each Bastion is filled with tough enemies, valuable loot, and rare progression items.
Exploring them becomes essential if you want to advance efficiently.

Inside Bastion chests, you can now find Eyes of Ender.
Even End Portal Frames are hidden within these dangerous fortresses, changing the way players reach the End dimension.

Progression is no longer tied only to strongholds — Bastions become a central part of your adventure.

The mod also introduces a special automated farming block.
This block gives you complete resources, saving time and increasing efficiency.

However, obtaining it requires facing the chaos you unleash.

Chaotic Cow blends absurd mechanics with strategic progression.
Will you dare to strike a cow and unleash the Bastions?
